focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须加速碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期最终版申报指南，强调对进口钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力和氢产品的嵌入碳排放核算将采用更严格默认值规则。中国相关出口企业若未建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，将面临高额成本与申报风险。建议企业立即核查供应链碳数据，完善MRV体系，并关注欧盟认可的第三方核查机构名单。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会税务与海关同盟总司 · 2026.10.23
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Must Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with definitive levies starting in 2027. The European Commission recently issued final guidance for transitional reporting, emphasizing stricter default value rules for embedded emissions in imported steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity, and hydrogen. Chinese exporters without product-level carbon footprint accounting systems face significant cost and reporting risks. Companies should immediately verify supply chain carbon data, enhance MRV systems, and monitor the list of EU-accredited verifiers.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭首例适用《新加坡调解公约》执行和解协议案，明确跨境执行路径
case.summary: 新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）近期在一宗涉及中资企业的跨境贸易纠纷中，首次依据《新加坡调解公约》承认并执行经国际调解达成的和解协议。该案确立：和解协议需满足“书面形式”“调解过程可证明”及“商事争议”三要件，且被申请人未提出有效抗辩。此案为中国企业通过调解解决跨境争议后直接申请执行提供了重要先例，提示企业注重调解协议的形式合规与证据留存。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭公报 · 2026.10
case.title_en: SICC First to Enforce Settlement Agreement under Singapore Convention, Clarifying Cross-Border Enforcement Path
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced an internationally mediated settlement agreement under the Singapore Convention on Mediation for the first time in a cross-border trade dispute involving a Chinese enterprise. The court established three requirements: written form, provable mediation process, and commercial dispute, with no valid defence raised by the respondent. This case provides a significant precedent for Chinese companies seeking direct enforcement of mediated settlements and highlights the need for formal compliance and evidence preservation in mediation agreements.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，港澳企业内地数据处理享便利化通道
policy.summary: 国家网信办与广东省近期联合发布粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施，允许符合条件的港澳企业在内地指定区域（如深圳前海、珠海横琴）进行数据跨境传输时适用简化安全评估程序。新规明确“白名单”机制，对低风险行业数据出境实行备案制，并建立大湾区数据跨境流动争议解决机制。企业需关注行业负面清单，及时完成数据出境合规自评。
policy.source: 来源：国家互联网信息办公室、广东省人民政府 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area Offer Facilitation for Hong Kong and Macao Enterprises
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China and Guangdong Province recently issued facilitation measures for cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area, allowing eligible Hong Kong and Macao enterprises to use simplified security assessment procedures for data transfers within designated mainland areas (e.g., Shenzhen Qianhai, Zhuhai Hengqin). The rules introduce a 'whitelist' mechanism, filing-based management for low-risk sectors, and a dispute resolution mechanism for cross-border data flows. Companies should monitor sectoral negative lists and complete compliance self-assessments.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of China; Guangdong Provincial People's Government · Oct 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中企需重构跨境交易架构与合规防火墙
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部外国投资委员会（CFIUS）近期强化对华科技领域投资审查，并拟将审查范围扩展至人工智能、量子计算等新兴领域。中国出海企业应重新评估对美投资及涉及美国技术的交易架构，提前进行CFIUS风险筛查，并在交易文件中设置针对性保护条款。同时，建议企业建立内部合规防火墙，分离敏感技术团队与数据，以降低审查风险。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部CFIUS年度报告 · 2026.10
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Review Requires Chinese Firms to Restructure Cross-Border Deals and Compliance Firewalls
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury's CFIUS has recently tightened scrutiny of investments in Chinese technology sectors and plans to extend review to emerging areas such as AI and quantum computing. Chinese companies expanding abroad should reassess US-bound investments and deal structures involving US technology, conduct early CFIUS risk screening, and incorporate targeted protective clauses in transaction documents. Establishing internal compliance firewalls to segregate sensitive technology teams and data is also recommended to mitigate review risks.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Treasury CFIUS Annual Report · Oct 2026
